description: This Java source file defines a deserializer component for handling JSON input related to charge definitions in the Apache Fineract project. It includes validation logic for creating and updating charge configuration data, parses JSON parameters, and manages various charge-related domains such as applies to entities (loan, savings, client, shares), charge timing, calculation types, and additional configurations.

classes.name: ChargeDefinitionCommandFromApiJsonDeserializer
classes.description: A Spring component class responsible for deserializing and validating JSON payloads for charge definitions in the Fineract API, supporting creation and update operations with thorough validation logic.

methods.name: validateForCreate
methods.description: Validates a JSON string for the creation of a charge definition, parsing parameters, and ensuring data consistency according to charge applicability (loan, savings, client, shares), timing, calculation type, and additional configurations.

methods.name: validateForUpdate
methods.description: Validates a JSON string for updating an existing charge definition, allowing partial updates and checking individual parameters for correctness and consistency.

methods.name: validateChargeTimeNCalculationType
methods.description: Validates that the combination of charge time and calculation type are compatible based on business rules.

methods.name: performChargeTimeNCalculationTypeValidation
methods.description: Performs detailed validation of the relationship between charge time type and calculation type, ensuring they adhere to specific valid combinations.

methods.name: throwExceptionIfValidationWarningsExist
methods.description: Throws an exception if there are any accumulated validation errors.
